# Servexa

> Servexa is field service management software for fire protection and building safety contractors — jobs, engineers, assets, compliance, and service reports in one place.

## Pages

- [Product overview](/servexa): Preview of the Servexa dashboard and how field service teams use it.
- [Sign in / sign up](/auth): Access the Servexa app.
